items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I had only one uncle, my uncle John... And the first time he heard me sing “Pennies From Heaven” he comes up to me and he says you know that thing you sang in there? That’s not in the song.

ctx.x: Somebody played. Oh yeah, they had a piano player I guess. There was accompaniment. I wasn’t alone. But when I think of it I was just seven or eight. And that was sort of bizarre. And I very rarely run through this in my mind, and connecting it to later things, you know. So it started then. And then I kept singing and then my parents left Ohio — not professionally or anything, just amateur. My father had — I had only one uncle, my uncle John. And my father was sort of on the square side and John was the direct…
